scope: Read-only audit of stored JSON; no benchmark reruns. Percentiles use linear interpolation as in NumPy.

experiments/python-fast-entropy-study/re.evidence: Paired actual Python wall timings under uncontrolled concurrent host load, not native/FPGA timing

experiments/python-fast-entropy-study/an.evidence: Actual paired Python wall time under uncontrolled host load; not target/native or hardware FPS

experiments/python-key-prepare-study/res.evidence: Actual Python host wall time; exact packet and receiver RGB hash comparison, no hardware/native real-time claim

experiments/python-measured-service-stud.evidence: Actual Python per-selected-packet prepare/receive duration replay into a finite stage model; offline calls, not concurrent wall throughput/native/FPGA timing

experiments/python-arithmetic-study/resu.evidence: Analytical intermediate bounds plus actual paired Python arithmetic; not a DSP schedule or hardware FPS proof

experiments/python-token-entropy-study/r.evidence: Actual paired Python wall time; no hardware/native or sustained FPS qualification

experiments/python-token-entropy-study/s.evidence: Actual per-selected-call Python preparation and optionally receive durations replayed into finite model; not native/concurrent/hardware FPS
